ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 5
   C. 13
   D. 36

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

3. Solve for x: x + 8 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 8
   C. 19
   D. 11

4. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 0
   D. 16

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 14

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 3
   C. 21
   D. 15

7. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 24
   C. 11
   D. 25

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 18

10. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

11. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 33

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
